description: This file contains utility functions for analyzing and reporting the exportability of PyTorch models, including generating inputs for submodules and attempting to export modules to identify issues.

methods.name: _generate_inputs_for_submodules
methods.description: Generates input data for specified submodules of a PyTorch model by registering pre-forward hooks and executing the model.

methods.name: report_exportability
methods.description: Analyzes a PyTorch model to identify exportability issues by attempting to export each submodule and capturing exceptions.
